defaults.description: Suggested values the user can change. Same keys as the enforced settings.

captureAddressBar.description: Catch go/name typed in the address bar (and searches for exactly "go/name") and open the link.

openInNewTab.description: Open links from the popup and the directory in a new tab instead of the current one.

caseInsensitive.description: Match link names regardless of upper/lower case (go/Payroll = go/payroll).

refreshHours.description: How often shared link lists are re-downloaded, in hours.

sharePersonalLinks.description: When a shared backend is linked, also upload this person's own links.

sourceUrls.description: Link-list URLs (JSON) added for everyone. They appear under Sources and cannot be removed by the user.

brand.description: Enforced brand kit fields (locked in Settings -> Branding).

connection.description: Optional shared-data backend. type: none | webhook | rest | supabase.
